description: This Java source file defines the `TimerWrapper` class, which implements a proxy wrapper to measure and log execution time of methods invoked on a delegate object. It utilizes reflection and Log4j logging to facilitate timing functionalities.

classes.name: TimerWrapper
classes.description: A final class implementing the Wrapper interface that wraps an object to log the execution time of its methods.

methods.name: TimerWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TimerWrapper with the delegate object to be wrapped.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls the method on the delegate object, measures execution time, and logs the duration.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs the class name, method name, and execution time of the invoked method.
